d: Weaves a Veil of Night that hides your units from enemy eyes and arrows (2 mana).

spell.h: within 4 to darken it and its 6 neighbours.
spell.d: darken a hex within 4 and its 6 neighbours until your 2nd turn after casting. Enemies cannot see into it, and only enemies next to your units there can target them; splash still lands. An enemy flare on it blows it away. Each Duskweaver keeps one Veil.
